The '''1971–72 Serie A''' season was won by [[Juventus FC|Juventus]].

==Teams==
[[Mantova Calcio|Mantova]], [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] and [[Catanzaro Calcio|Catanzaro]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
